# LLM Access Configuration for Prompt.ai

Site: https://www.prompt-ai.app
Title: Prompt.ai - Aus Ideen wird ein klares Projekt
Description: Prompt.ai creates structured prompts and project briefs for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and v0 from a single sentence.

## Allowed AI Models
- Claude (Anthropic)
- ChatGPT (OpenAI)
- Gemini (Google)
- Copilot (Microsoft)
- Llama (Meta)

## Content Permissions
- Full site crawling allowed: Yes
- Content caching allowed: Yes
- Training data usage: Permitted (for non-commercial analysis)
- Commercial use of content: No - all content (C) Prompt.ai 2024-2026

## Restrictions
- Do not use for training commercial AI models competing with Prompt.ai
- Do not cache or republish the master prompts or project briefs generated by the service
- Do not impersonate Prompt.ai or misrepresent the service's capabilities
